consensus.executive_summary: The three papers agree that 4-bit quantization changes accuracy by a measurable amount, but they disagree on how safe it is. Example A (2024) finds negligible loss on short-context MMLU and calls 4-bit safe; Example B (2025) finds a 7.9 point LongBench drop at 32k context and warns against assuming safety. Example C (2025) suggests calibration data explains much of the variance. Multilingual behavior is untested in every paper.
agreed_findings: Long-context accuracy is sensitive to 4-bit quantization choices (Example B 2025, Example C 2025).

top_contradictions.headline: Is 4-bit quantization safe to deploy? Example A says yes, Example B says not for long context.

recommended_next_steps: Re-run Example A's short-context benchmark at 32k context with the same quantizer.
Repeat Example B's evaluation with multiple calibration corpora as in Example C.
Add multilingual calibration and evaluation sets.
